input._script:
using JSON3, Base64
using Random
d = mktempdir()
write(joinpath(d, "STADE.jl"), base64decode(""))
write(joinpath(d, "transformer.jl"), base64decode(""))
include(joinpath(d, "STADE.jl"))
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["julia"] = string(VERSION)
res["hash_transformer"] = string(hash("transformer"))
Random.seed!(1); res["rand_seed1"] = rand(3:5, 8)
Random.seed!(hash("transformer")); res["rand_hashseed"] = rand(3:5, 8)
path = joinpath(d, "transformer.jl")
primal = STADE.io_read_corpus_entry(path)
kernel = STADE.parse_kernel(primal)
primal_fn = STADE.val_compile(primal)
sig = kernel.sig
ndims_of = Dict(a => STADE.val_arg_ndims(kernel, a) for a in sig.args if sig.kinds[a] in (:array_float, :array_int))
int_args = Dict{Symbol,Int}(:n => 3, :dk => 3, :h => 3, :dff => 4, :n_layers => 3)
errs = Dict{String,Any}()
for N in (4, 16, 64, 256)
    for cap in (4, 64)
        shapes = Dict(a => ntuple(_ -> N, ndims_of[a]) for a in keys(ndims_of))
        trial = STADE.val_random_values(kernel, shapes, int_args; scale = 1.0, idx_cap = cap)
        key = "N$N cap$cap"
        try
            call_args = Any[sig.kinds[a] == :scalar_int ? int_args[a] : deepcopy(trial[a]) for a in sig.args]
            Base.invokelatest(primal_fn, call_args...)
            errs[key] = "ok"
        catch e
            errs[key] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 1800)
        end
    end
end
res["attempts"] = errs
res["sig_args"] = string(sig.args)
println(JSON3.write(res))
